scientific_integrity: Analytical proof supplies global path and center optimization; finite numerical checks are diagnostic, not a proof over a continuum.
scientific_limitations: Only the lateral intrinsic surface of a finite right circular cone (excluding its base disk), with 0<R/L<1.
Uniform normalized intrinsic area is assumed for the Fréchet least-squares centers.
No result asserted for noncircular cones, frusta, or arbitrary metric cones.
The two isolated parameter values are defined by unique transcendental roots; decimals are approximations.
Historical priority is assessed against inspected accessible literature and records, not exhaustively established.
title: Intrinsic minimax and least-squares centers of a finite circular cone
